name: Filip Sedic
current_role: Founder and CEO / 'chief imagination officer', FOREO (Swedish beauty-tech brand)
profile: Bosnian-born Swedish inventor based in Hong Kong who founded beauty-tech brand FOREO in 2013 (LUNA, ISSA, UFO devices). Earlier he co-founded Lelo and the feminine-care brand Intimina. He still leads FOREO and its FAQ Swiss skincare line.
interesting_fact: FOREO's name stands for 'for everyone'; Sedic says 'We are probably the most copied brand in the world' and doesn't mind if copiers improve things.
deep_cut_fact: Before consumer products, he ran a digital marketing agency in Sweden in the 1990s and worked at Ericsson from 2000 to 2005.
notes: Press email is FOREO Sweden's Marketing & PR manager from a Cision release (Nordic market); may be regional. Sources variously title him CEO, Chief Innovation Officer or chief imagination officer.

name: Mayank Singhal
current_role: Vice Chairperson and Managing Director, PI Industries Ltd (India)
profile: Son of PI Industries chairman emeritus Salil Singhal, he joined the agrochemicals/agri-sciences company in 1996, became Joint MD in 2004 and MD & CEO in 2009, and has been Vice Chairperson & MD since 2019. PI has partnered with 25+ global innovators and has expanded into pharma via PI Health Sciences.
interesting_fact: Named 'CEO of the Year' in the agriculture sector by Business Today; sits on the advisory board of Boston University's Institute for Global Sustainability.
deep_cut_fact: Beyond agrochemicals he sits on the board of Fratelli Wines, is a founding member of Brookings India and has been a YPO Delhi Chapter member since 2013.
notes: Engineering and management graduate from the UK (per PI site). Company general email info@piind.com also appears in its filings.

name: Shi Changjia
current_role: Founder and former chairman ('老董事长'), Grace / 洁丽雅 Group (Zhuji, Zhejiang); no longer chairman
profile: Founder of Grace (洁丽雅), one of China's best-known towel and home-textile brands, based in Zhuji, Shaoxing. The group grew from a small towel factory founded in 1986 into a multi-billion-yuan integrated spinning-to-retail group. A 2026 report describes him as the former chairman; the next generation now runs the company.
interesting_fact: Grace began as the Zhuji County Towel Factory (诸暨县毛巾厂) in 1986 and was formally organised as a group in 2003, growing from a small towel workshop into an industry leader.
notes: Alive status inferred from a May 2026 report saying he follows online comments about the brand (https://wap.stockstar.com/detail/IG2026051800002862). The company and family have been in the news over succession; avoid that topic. Best route is via the company.

name: Hu Jidan
current_role: Individual shareholder (domestic natural person) among the top 10 shareholders of Xiamen Yealink Network Technology (SZSE: 300628); no executive role found
profile: Hu Jidan (胡继丹) appears in Yealink's 2024 annual report as one of the company's ten largest shareholders, holding unrestricted shares as a domestic individual. Yealink is a Xiamen-based maker of enterprise video-conferencing and VoIP communications equipment. No biography or management role was found.
notes: Very low public profile; not listed as director or executive. Shareholding confirmed in Yealink 2024 annual report (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-04-21/1223154940.PDF) and Q1 2025 report. Only route is via the company. Website is the company's, not his.

name: Qi Jianping
current_role: Former legal representative / controlling-family shareholder of Zhejiang Honglei Copper (宏磊铜业, SZSE 002647); current role not found
profile: Qi Jianping (戚建萍) was the legal representative of Zhejiang Honglei Copper Co., a Zhuji (Datang town) maker of enamelled wire and high-precision copper tubes, when it listed on the Shenzhen exchange in December 2011. The listed company's controlling shareholder changed in 2016, after which it underwent major asset restructuring. No recent public information on her activities was found.
interesting_fact: Honglei Copper's December 2011 Shenzhen IPO filing lists her as the company's legal representative, with the company registered in Datang town, Zhuji, Zhejiang.
notes: Very low profile; no published contact found. The listed company's controlling shareholder changed in 2016, so company channels are unlikely to be a route.

name: Cheng Lixin
current_role: Founder and former chairman/GM of Jiangyin Hengrun Heavy Industries (恒润股份, SSE 603985); per 2025-26 filings now a 5%+ shareholder, not controlling shareholder
profile: Born May 1967, Cheng Lixin (承立新) has led Jiangyin Hengrun since 2003 (executive director, then chairman and general manager) and took it public in 2017, holding 48% before the IPO. Hengrun makes rolled ring forgings, chiefly wind-turbine tower flanges sold to global wind-equipment makers. Recent filings describe him as a 5%+ shareholder rather than controller.
interesting_fact: Hengrun's core product is wind-tower flanges—the rolled steel rings that join tower sections—sold mainly to international and domestic wind-turbine makers; a direct link to the energy theme.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Hengrun he was general manager (1998-2003) of Jiangyin Suyuan Donghai Electric Power Equipment, formerly the Jiangyin Donghai Electrical Complete-Set Factory; he is a senior economist by title.
notes: Recent company filings involve his shares being judicially frozen/auctioned and a CSRC penalty under review; avoid these topics. No personal published contact; he no longer appears to control the listed company, so company IR is not a reliable route.

name: Liu Qiong
current_role: Director, Yixintang Pharmaceutical Group (一心堂, SZSE 002727); Chairman & President, Hualong Sheng'ai Traditional Chinese Medicine Group (华龙圣爱中医集团)
profile: Born 1965, Liu Qiong (刘琼) is a long-time executive and major shareholder (about 67.5m shares) of Yunnan-based pharmacy chain Yixintang, where she has been a director since 2010 after roles in finance, marketing and procurement at its Hongxiang predecessors. Since 2010 she has chaired Hualong Sheng'ai, a TCM clinic group.
interesting_fact: She runs a separate chain of traditional Chinese medicine clinics, Hualong Sheng'ai, with clinics in Kunming, Jiangsu, Hubei and Chongqing, plus TCM research, education and elder-care affiliates.
deep_cut_fact: She started in June 1987 as finance manager of the Kaiyuan Hongxiang medicinal-herbs business, later managed the Hongxiang Chinese-Western pharmacy, and holds a licensed-pharmacist (从业药师) qualification.
notes: Details from Yixintang 2025 annual report (published April 2026). Board term runs to Nov 2028.

name: Guo Jingsong
current_role: Founder and former chairman of Sotech Smarter Equipment (松德智慧装备, SZSE 300173, now Funeng Oriental Equipment Technology); current role not found
profile: Born 1962, an engineer by training, Guo Jingsong (郭景松) founded Zhongshan Debao Packaging Machinery in 1997, which became Sotech, a maker of gravure printing machines and later intelligent automated manufacturing equipment; he chaired it from 2000 (listed company from 2007). Foshan Public Utilities Holding took a stake in 2019 and the company was later renamed Funeng Oriental.
interesting_fact: He won a first-class Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology award and in March 2017 was named a 'Zhongshan Science and Technology Innovation Leader'; he was also vice-chairman of the gravure printing branch of the China Printing Technology Association.
deep_cut_fact: He began his career (1983-1992) as an engineer at the Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources' Hengyang Exploration Machinery Plant, then was deputy director of Shunde Debao Packaging Machinery Factory before founding his own company in 1997.
notes: Bio from Sotech's 2018 annual report. The listed company (now Funeng Oriental, sec@fnorient.com) is controlled by Foshan Public Utilities; he appears in its 2025 report only as a party to earlier performance commitments, so company channels may not reach him.

name: Fang Xiubao
current_role: Former controlling shareholder (37.5% at end-2017) and legal representative of Zhejiang Doyin Pump Industry (东音股份, SZSE 002793); current role not found
profile: Fang Xiubao (方秀宝) built Zhejiang Doyin Pump Industry in Daxi town, Wenling, Zhejiang, a maker of well-submersible pumps, small submersible pumps and land pumps that listed in Shenzhen. As of 2018 filings he was its legal representative and controlling shareholder. No recent information on his activities was found.
interesting_fact: Doyin specialises in well-submersible (deep-well) pumps, small submersible pumps and land pumps, from a base in Wenling, Zhejiang.
notes: Low public profile. Role/shareholding from Doyin's 2018 convertible-bond prospectus summary (https://disc.static.szse.cn/disc/disk01/finalpage/2018-07-31/47fc4998-0957-4cbf-be2a-bf3bdd394e70.PDF). Current ownership of the listed company not verified; no published contact for him found.

name: Chen Hongchao
current_role: Major individual shareholder (4.75% at end-2025) of Peacebird (太平鸟, SSE 603877); former director and general manager, resigned all company posts (announced 7 Feb, c.2023)
profile: A Peacebird veteran described as on a par with founder-chairman Zhang Jiangping, Chen Hongchao (陈红朝) was a director from 2012 and general manager from April 2017 (after the January 2017 IPO) for about six years, also heading the women's-wear division (Peacebird Women, Lautomn, MG). He resigned for personal reasons and remains a top-four shareholder.
interesting_fact: He ran Peacebird's women's apparel division, covering the Peacebird women's line, Lautomn (乐町) and MG brands, and was the company's No. 2 shareholder after the parent group as of 2022.
notes: No longer holds any position at Peacebird, so company IR is not a route. Shareholding from Peacebird 2025 annual report (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-04-17/1225112527.PDF); 'alive' inferred from his listing as a natural-person shareholder there. Resignation year inferred as 2023 from the article context.

name: Thomas T. Edman
current_role: Former President & CEO (2014-Sept 2025) and director of TTM Technologies; director of Jabil and Ultra Clean Holdings per SEC insider filings
profile: Tom Edman ran Applied Films (CEO 1998-2006) until Applied Materials bought it, then held VP roles at Applied Materials including GM of its AKT Display business. He led PCB/RF maker TTM Technologies as CEO from 2014, pushing it into aerospace & defense and data-center/generative-AI computing, and retired as CEO when Edwin Roks took over on 2 Sept 2025.
interesting_fact: Under his leadership TTM broadened its focus to Data Center Computing and Networking markets supporting generative AI; in mid-2025 TTM reported the strongest first half in its history for revenue growth and margins.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a Yale BA in East Asian studies (Japan) and, before Applied Films, was General Manager of the High-Performance Materials Division of Marubeni Specialty Chemicals; he has also sat on the IPC (electronics industry association) board since 2016.
notes: Strong fit for a data-center podcast (AI server PCBs, display/semicap background). IPC board fact: https://www.electronics.org/tom-edman. Search snippets hinted at a 2026 board change at TTM that I could not verify; check whether he remains a TTM director. Contacts are TTM corporate IR/marketing from a July 2025 release.

name: Man Yize
current_role: Director (since the joint-stock company's first board), Leysen Tesiro Jewelry / 莱绅通灵珠宝 (SSE 603900); sits on its audit and remuneration committees
profile: Man Yize (蔄毅泽) has been a shareholder of Nanjing-based jeweller Tesiro (formerly Jiangsu Tesiro Diamond, now Leysen Tesiro) since 2011 and a board director through all five boards since its conversion to a joint-stock company; she held 5.51% (18.9m shares) at end-2025. Her wealth is shared with chairman Ma Jun.
interesting_fact: She became a shareholder in December 2011 when Ma Jun transferred a 4.52% stake to her, giving her 9% of Jiangsu Tesiro Diamond, which converted into a joint-stock company that same month.
notes: Low public profile; listed with Ma Jun (joint wealth). Role/shareholding from 2025 annual report. Avoid regulatory topics (2022 CSRC Jiangsu shareholding-reduction order mentioned in the report). Company IR is the only route.

name: Ashok Kumar Goel
current_role: Non-executive, non-independent director of Hindustan Oil Exploration Co. (since 2018); former Chairman & MD of Essel Propack (now EPL Ltd)
profile: Long-time head of Mumbai-based Essel Propack, the world's largest maker of laminated tubes (toothpaste, pharma and cosmetics tubes), and a member of the Essel Group promoter family. In 2019 his family's Ashok Goel Trust sold a 51% stake to Blackstone at Rs 134 a share. He now holds board roles including at oil & gas producer Hindustan Oil Exploration.
interesting_fact: With about a third of the global oral-care tube market, Essel pivoted to pharma and cosmetics tubes, which Goel said fetch roughly 2x and 3-4x oral-care prices: 'So suddenly, our market size nearly tripled.'
notes: Described by Business Standard (2011) as reticent and media-shy. Energy angle: board seat at Hindustan Oil Exploration (per MarketScreener/Tofler, DIN 00025350). MarketScreener also lists an independent directorship at Nilkamal from 2023 (unverified). Blackstone deal: https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/blackstone-to-acquire-majority-stake-in-essel-propack

name: Liu Zhongliang
current_role: Controlling shareholder and actual controller (c.65% control) of Zhejiang Wecome Pharmaceutical (维康药业, SZSE 300878); former chairman
profile: Liu Zhongliang (刘忠良) controls Zhejiang Wecome Pharmaceutical, a Lishui-based maker of modern traditional Chinese medicines (e.g. Yinhuang dropping pills, motherwort soft capsules) and Western drugs listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext board; it also runs TCM clinics and regional drug distribution. He holds 60.89% directly and no longer chairs the board.
interesting_fact: Wecome's R&D platforms include a provincial academician expert workstation, a postdoctoral workstation and a 'Nobel Prize workstation' (诺贝尔奖工作站).
notes: Sensitive: in July 2025 the CSRC Zhejiang bureau fined him and the company over non-operating fund occupation (funds since repaid); avoid. Company 2025 report lists 'no website'. 'Alive' inferred from 2025-26 filings naming him as actual controller.

name: Brian D. Connolly
current_role: Co-founder and portfolio manager, Millstreet Capital Management LLC; independent director of Aware, Inc. (since Jan 2012); reported 10% owner of Diebold Nixdorf per SEC insider data
profile: Investor who co-founded Millstreet Capital Management in 2010 after credit/equity research roles at Fidelity and Regiment Capital. His SEC insider listing as a 10% owner of ATM and banking-tech maker Diebold Nixdorf likely reflects Millstreet-managed holdings. He has sat on the board of Aware since 2012.
interesting_fact: He has served on Aware's board since January 2012 and has more than 20 years in investing, per Aware's proxy statement.
deep_cut_fact: Before co-founding Millstreet he was a research analyst at Fidelity Management & Research (2000-2005) and a senior analyst at Regiment Capital Advisors (2005-2008); he holds a Harvard BA and an MIT Sloan MBA.
notes: The Diebold 10%-owner status comes from SEC insider data in the input; I did not confirm it in a filing (likely via Millstreet funds after Diebold's restructuring). No published personal contact; best route is via Millstreet Capital.

name: Guo Xiumei
current_role: Former chairman (resigned Jan 2020) and former controlling shareholder of Shenzhen Road Rover Technology (路畅科技, SZSE 002813); sold 29.99% to Zoomlion in 2022
profile: Guo Xiumei (郭秀梅) was chairman and controlling shareholder of Shenzhen Road Rover Technology, an automotive-electronics maker of smart cockpits, digital instrument clusters, 360-degree camera systems, T-BOX, ADAS and HUD products. She stepped down as chairman in January 2020, and in February 2022 agreed to sell a 29.99% stake to Zoomlion (中联重科), waiving voting rights on her remaining shares until June 2025.
interesting_fact: Road Rover struck strategic partnerships with Tencent, Baidu and Alibaba to develop connected-car and vehicle-intelligence products, and worked on autonomous-driving solutions.
notes: Zoomlion deal from her Feb 2022 equity-change report (https://disc.static.szse.cn/disc/disk03/finalpage/2022-02-10/8c4a63b7-8c88-44e6-90f3-3b95c6935ce2.PDF). No longer controls the company; no published personal contact found. Low public profile.

name: Paddy McKillen
current_role: Property investor and hotelier; owner of Château La Coste (Provence); known for long-term ownership and restoration of London's Maybourne Hotel Group
profile: Belfast-born (1955) property investor who built a portfolio of shopping centres and commercial buildings across Ireland in the 1980s (incl. Dublin's Jervis Street and Powerscourt Townhouse centres) before moving into international property in the 1990s. Known for Maybourne (Claridge's, The Connaught, The Berkeley) and for Château La Coste, a wine estate turned art-and-architecture destination.
interesting_fact: Château La Coste in Provence pairs vineyards and the Villa La Coste hotel with art and architecture by Tadao Ando, Louise Bourgeois and Frank Gehry; in 2022 he opened a Tadao Ando-designed hotel in Gion, Kyoto.
deep_cut_fact: He serves as Honorary Consul of Vietnam in Ireland and is developing a biotechnology campus in Vietnam with a university, research facilities and a hospital; Ulster University gave him an honorary Doctor of Science in 2022.
notes: Contacts are for Château La Coste (his estate), not him personally; the press email is listed on the estate's press page for press requests.
